datasheet.title: 500mW 5.1-Volt Silicon Planar Zener Diode
datasheet.package: DO-35 Hermetically Sealed Axial Glass Package
datasheet.description: The BZX55C5V1 is a precision 5.1V Zener diode engineered for voltage stabilization, rail regulation, ADC voltage clamping, and overvoltage surge suppression.

pinout.name: Anode (+)
pinout.desc: Connects to lower potential or Ground in reverse regulation mode

pinout.name: Cathode (-)
pinout.desc: Marked with black cathode band, connects to regulated voltage rail

datasheet.appNotes: Always place a current-limiting series resistor R_S between the unregulated input and the Zener cathode to keep diode dissipation within 500mW: R_S = (V_in - V_Z) / (I_Z + I_load).
